testCases.title: Categories | 1- Display 5-Star category with star symbols on package card (Positive)(P1)
testCases.preconditions: User is on the Select Package screen with search results populated.
steps: 1. Locate the package card for '5 Stars ✨ Galleria Hotel arrival 12 Oct'.
2. Inspect the metadata lines beneath the hotel name.

testCases.title: Categories | 2- Display 4-Star category with star symbols on package card (Positive)(P2)
testCases.preconditions: User is on the Select Package screen with search results populated.
steps: 1. Locate the package card for '4 Stars ✨ Novotel Hotel arrival 12 Oct'.
2. Inspect the metadata lines beneath the hotel name.

testCases.title: Categories | 3- Verify category display on dimmed package card that cannot accommodate party (Positive)(P2)
testCases.preconditions: User is on the Select Package screen where party size exceeds a package's capacity.
steps: 1. Scroll to the dimmed card for '3 Stars ✨ ibis Hotel arrival 12 Oct'.
2. Inspect the metadata lines in the package card body.
testCases.expected: TBD - confirm with dev whether dimmed unavailable package cards must display the Category line alongside Night count.

testCases.title: Categories | 4- Render star rating emoji without character corruption or wrapping (Edge case)(P3)
testCases.preconditions: User is viewing package cards on the Select Package screen across desktop and mobile browsers.
steps: 1. Observe the Category line on all visible package cards.
2. Verify the rendering of the star emojis (⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐).
testCases.expected: Star emojis render consistently across browsers without square fallback glyphs or breaking across multiple lines.

testCases.title: Categories | 5- Retain selected package category in Package Details header (Positive)(P1)
testCases.preconditions: User is on the Select Package screen viewing the '5 Stars ✨ Galleria Hotel arrival 12 Oct' card with category 'Olympics 5-Star ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐'.
steps: 1. Click the 'Select Package' button on the Galleria Hotel card.
2. Inspect the header summary block on the Package Details screen.
testCases.expected: The header displays 'Category Olympics 5-Star ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐' alongside Passengers and Dates.

testCases.title: Categories | 6- Handle package with missing category attribute on Package Details (Negative)(P2)
testCases.preconditions: A package record with a null or empty category attribute is loaded directly via URL.
steps: 1. Navigate to the Package Details screen for the package lacking category data.
2. Inspect the header metadata block.
testCases.expected: TBD - confirm with dev whether the Category label is omitted gracefully or if a fallback default is displayed.

testCases.title: Categories | 7- Display category on mobile viewport Package Details layout (Edge case)(P3)
testCases.preconditions: User accesses Package Details on a mobile viewport (width <= 390px).
steps: 1. View the top summary block and the collapsed '▸ Hotel & inclusions' block.
2. Tap to expand '▸ Hotel & inclusions'.
testCases.expected: TBD - confirm with dev whether Category is presented in the top summary or within the expanded Hotel & inclusions drawer on mobile.

testCases.title: Categories | 8- Verify category filter control availability on Select Package screen (Validation)(P2)
testCases.preconditions: User is on the Select Package screen with 14 packages listed.
steps: 1. Inspect the filter area and search summary bar above the package list.
2. Check for category filter options (e.g., 5-Star, 4-Star, 3-Star).
testCases.expected: TBD - confirm with dev whether packages can be filtered by Category on Screen 1 matching Screen 3's filter pattern.

testCases.title: Categories | 9- Maintain package category labels after modifying search criteria (Positive)(P2)
testCases.preconditions: User is on the Select Package screen with categorized packages displayed.
steps: 1. Click '[ Modify Search ]' in the search summary bar.
2. Change guest counts and apply search.
3. Review the Category labels on the refreshed package cards.
testCases.expected: Each returned package maintains its correct Olympic star category classification.

testCases.title: Categories | 10- Sanitize special characters or markup in Category API response (Edge case)(P3)
testCases.preconditions: User initiates package search where API returns package data containing special characters or HTML tags in the category field.
steps: 1. Execute search on the Select Package screen.
2. Inspect the rendered Category text in the package card and Package Details header.
testCases.expected: Category text is sanitized and rendered as plain text without breaking layout or executing script.
